paragraphs: AI: "AI Leaders Are Asking to Be Regulated. This Is Nothing New.: News Article" (Independent Institute) leads the coverage. Also notable: "AI models could harm young people's body image, warn experts" (BBC).

Political: "Federal judge rules warrantless Flock camera searches may violate 4th Amendment" (The Hill) leads the coverage. Also notable: "As She Divorces Ken Paxton, His Wife Urges Texans to Vote for Him" (The New York Times).

Economic: "Fed, ECB Minutes to Show Inflation Fears as Hike Bets Fade" (Bloomberg) leads the coverage. Also notable: "Stop telling Americans the economy is booming — living here has become a luxury" (Washington Examiner).

Financial: "‘Digger,’ Warner Bros.’ Last Release Before Merger, Is a Major Flop" (The New York Times) leads the coverage. Also notable: "F.D.A. Classifies Salad Dressing Recall to Highest Health Risk" (The New York Times).

Geopolitical: "Hegseth indicates some US troops could be redeployed from Europe to Western Hemisphere" (The Hill) leads the coverage. Also notable: "Mexico TV correspondent and cameraman are slammed by SUV during live broadcast: video" (New York Post).
